english: Daily call-in data: what it is, who submits and validates it, and how to keep it accurate.
Call-in data are daily reports that OICs submit during MDA rounds. They give real-time updates on CDD deployment, drug availability and coverage.

CDD teams record every child reached in two age groups: 1–11 months and 12–59 months.
At the end of each day, each team totals the children reached in both age groups.
These totals must match the number of children recorded in the DIGIT HCM app.
The OIC adds up the totals from all CDD teams in the facility for each age group.
